biggest_catch: You get nothing until the referred person opens a consumer checking account with e-statements and completes 10 debit card transactions of $5+ each OR two direct deposits of $250+ each within 90 days of becoming a member - and the card takes 4-6 weeks to arrive.
catches: Referrer must register for the NIHFCU referral program and share the offer with friends, family, or coworkers who are not currently NIHFCU members.
Referred person must be 16+ and register via the referral link, email, or social media.

To earn the $50, the referred person must open an NIHFCU consumer checking account with e-statements and complete 10+ debit card transactions of $5+ each OR two direct deposits of $250+ each, all within 90 days of becoming an NIHFCU member.
Only consumer checking accounts are eligible; business checking accounts are not; NIHFCU employees are not eligible.
Referrer may receive up to $500 in Visa Reward Cards within a calendar year (10 referrals); only one referrer per referred person.
Visa Reward Card delivery 4-6 weeks after all requirements; cards valid 3 calendar months from issuance; may be reported as income to the IRS.
